words.gloss: furnished with moat, rampart, wall, gates and towers

hindi: वास्तु-विशेषज्ञ द्वारा प्रशंसित स्थान पर नायक, वर्धकि (बढ़ई) और मौहूर्तिक (ज्योतिषी) स्कन्धावार (शिविर) को मापें — गोल, लम्बा या चौकोर, अथवा भूमि के अनुसार — चार द्वारों, छह मार्गों और नौ विभागों वाला, खाई, वप्र (मिट्टी का घेरा), प्राकार, द्वारों और अट्टालकों (बुर्जों) से युक्त, भय के स्थान में और पड़ाव के स्थान में भी।
english: On a site approved by the site-expert, the nāyaka (commander), the carpenter and the astrologers should measure out the camp: circular, oblong or four-cornered, or according to the terrain; with four gates, six roads and nine divisions, furnished with moat, rampart, wall, gates and towers, both in a place of danger and at a halting place.
notes: nāyaka.vardhaki read as a dual dvandva (nāyaka-vardhakī) co-ordinated with mauhūrtikāḥ as subjects of māpayeyuḥ; the e-text's final short -i is kept as printed. 'bhaye sthāne ca' is literal 'in danger and at a halt'; it may mean 'when there is danger as well as at an ordinary halt'. vapra = earthen rampart; sāla = wall; aṭṭālaka = tower on the wall.

hindi: मध्य भाग के उत्तर में, नौवें भाग में, राजा का निवास (राजवास्तुक) हो, जो सौ धनुष लम्बा और उसका आधा चौड़ा हो; उसके पश्चिमी आधे भाग में अन्तःपुर हो।
english: To the north of the middle (division), in the ninth part, is the king's quarters, a hundred dhanus in length and half of that in width; in its western half is the inner apartments (antaḥpura).
notes: nava-bhāga is taken as 'the ninth part' (of the nine divisions of unit 1); 'nine parts' is also grammatically possible. dhanus is a measure of length (a bow-length).

hindi: और अन्तर्वंशिक सैन्य (भीतरी रक्षकों की टुकड़ी) उसके किनारे पर डेरा डाले।
english: And the troop of inner guards (antarvaṃśika) should encamp at its edge.
notes: ante: at the edge of the king's quarters (unit 2). antarvaṃśika = guard of the inner apartments.

words.gloss: offices of treasury, edicts and business

hindi: सामने उपस्थान (सभा-भवन) हो; दाहिनी ओर कोश, शासन (आज्ञापत्र) और कार्य के कार्यालय हों; बाईं ओर राजा की सवारी के हाथियों, घोड़ों और रथों का स्थान हो।
english: In front, the audience hall; on the right, the offices for treasury, edicts and business; on the left, the station of the king's riding elephants, horses and chariots.
notes: dakṣiṇataḥ / vāmataḥ may equally mean 'to the south / to the north' (right and left when facing east). karaṇa = office or workplace.

words.gloss: at intervals of a hundred dhanus
enclosures of carts, posts, creeper-hedges, pillars and walls

hindi: इसके बाद, सौ-सौ धनुष के अन्तर पर, गाड़ियों, मेथी (खूँटों), लताओं की बाड़, खम्भों और प्राकार के चार घेरे हों।
english: Beyond this, at intervals of a hundred dhanus, are four enclosures made of carts, posts (methī), creeper-hedges, pillars and walls.
notes: methī = a post or pillar (e.g. for tethering); pratati = a creeper, here taken as a hedge of creepers; the five materials may be distributed one to each successive enclosure rather than all together.

words.gloss: the store of raw materials and weapons

hindi: पहले घेरे में सामने मन्त्री और पुरोहित हों; दाहिनी ओर कोष्ठागार (भण्डार) और महानस (रसोईघर); बाईं ओर कुप्य (कच्चे माल) और आयुधों का भण्डार।
english: In the first (enclosure), in front, the minister and the chaplain; on the right, the storehouse and the kitchen; on the left, the store of raw materials and weapons.

text_flags.why: typo: ṇṣ for kṣ; the same word is dakṣiṇataḥ in unit 4 and the sense (right/south, paired with vāmataḥ) requires it

notes: kupya = forest produce / raw materials (metal, timber etc.).

words.gloss: of the hereditary and hired troops
of the commander of the army

hindi: दूसरे घेरे में मौल (वंशानुगत) और भृत (वेतनभोगी) सैनिकों का, घोड़ों और रथों का, तथा सेनापति का स्थान हो।
english: In the second, the station of the hereditary and hired troops, of the horses and chariots, and of the commander of the army.

hindi: तीसरे घेरे में हाथी, श्रेणी-सैन्य (संघों के सैनिक) और प्रशास्ता हों।
english: In the third, the elephants, the guild troops and the praśāstṛ (camp superintendent).
notes: śreṇī = troops supplied by guilds or corporations; praśāstṛ = the officer in charge of the camp and the march (also in unit 17).

words.gloss: the troops of allies, enemies and forest tribes

hindi: चौथे घेरे में विष्टि (मज़दूर-दल), नायक, तथा मित्रों, शत्रुओं और वन-जातियों की सेना हो, जो अपने ही पुरुषों की देखरेख में हो।
english: In the fourth, the labour corps, the nāyaka, and the troops of allies, of enemies and of forest tribes, supervised by (the king's) own men.
notes: amitra-bala = troops of a (former) enemy serving the king; amitra rendered 'enemy' per glossary.

hindi: व्यापारी और रूपाजीवा (गणिकाएँ) मुख्य मार्ग के किनारे हों।
english: Traders and courtesans (rūpājīvā) along the main road.
notes: rūpājīvā, literally 'one who lives by her beauty'.

hindi: बाहर कुत्तों के दल वाले शिकारी हों, तुरही और अग्नि सहित; और गुप्त रक्षक भी।
english: Outside, hunters with packs of dogs, equipped with trumpets and fires; and hidden guards.
notes: śva-gaṇin = having a pack of dogs; tūrya = musical instrument used for signalling.

words.gloss: wells, traps, pitfalls and thorny barriers

hindi: और शत्रुओं के आने के मार्ग पर कुएँ, कूट (छिपे जाल), अवपात (गड्ढे) और काँटेदार बाड़ें लगवाए।
english: And on the enemies' approach route he should set up wells, concealed traps, pitfalls and thorny barriers.
notes: The compound is feminine plural after its last member kaṇṭakinī (thorny hedge). kūṭa = concealed trap.

hindi: अठारह वर्गों की पहरेदारी का अदल-बदल करवाए।
english: He should have the guard duty of the eighteen groups rotated.
notes: The eighteen groups are not listed here; viparyāsa = interchange, so that no group keeps the same guard post.

words.gloss: for the sake of detecting spies

hindi: और गुप्तचरों का पता लगाने के लिए दिन में भी पहरा रखवाए।
english: And he should have a watch kept by day as well, for the sake of detecting spies.
notes: diva.āyāma as split in the e-text (diva + āyāma 'stretch, exertion'); the word is more naturally divā-yāma 'day watch' (yāma = a watch), which is how it is translated here. Either way the sense is a guard or muster kept during the day. apasarpa = spy.

words.gloss: prevention of quarrels, drinking, gatherings and gambling

hindi: और झगड़े, मद्यपान, जमघट और जुए की रोकथाम करवाए, तथा मुद्रा (पास) की जाँच भी।
english: And he should have quarrels, drinking, gatherings and gambling prevented, and the passes (mudrā) checked.
notes: saurika = relating to liquor (surā); mudrā = a seal or pass required for movement; rakṣaṇa here means enforcing it.

words.gloss: the regent (guardian of the empty capital)

hindi: सेना से बिना आज्ञा लौटे हुए सैनिक को शून्यपाल (राजा की अनुपस्थिति में राजधानी का रक्षक) बन्दी बना ले।
english: The śūnyapāla (the officer left in charge of the capital) should arrest a soldier who has come back from the army without orders.
notes: śūnya-pāla, literally 'guardian of the empty (place)': the officer who guards the capital while the king is away on campaign.

words.gloss: by the carpenters and the labour corps

hindi: प्रशास्ता मार्ग के आगे-आगे ठीक प्रकार से चले, और वर्धकियों (बढ़इयों) तथा विष्टि (मज़दूर-दल) से रक्षा के प्रबन्ध और जल की व्यवस्था करवाए।
english: The praśāstṛ should go ahead on the route in proper order, and should have protective works and water supplies made by the carpenters and the labour corps.
notes: samyak is taken as an adverb with yāyāt; the e-text joins it to praśāstā with a compound mark. rakṣaṇāni and udakāni are both objects of kārayet.
